claim: One pace floor per update cannot pace a game whose displaced work varies by figure; use windows on the displaced work, sized from the plain build.

evidence.text: One floor on a 332-line player update gave stretches of -13.1 to +13.9%; replaced by one window per displaced job (copy, attribute walk).
K alone: many-figure updates +10%, quiet -3%; a fixed debt per figure plus higher K flattened it, whole runs within 2%.
